description: A Python script for AST manipulation and round-trip testing, part of the 'astor' library, including functions for converting source files to ASTs, comparing ASTs, and handling file operations.

methods.name: out_prep
methods.description: Prepares string for output, encoding to UTF-8 if necessary based on Python version.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Main function to walk through source directory, parse Python files into ASTs, convert back to source code, and compare ASTs for round-trip integrity.
